conclusion: The combined detector improved aggregate F1 and event recall but increased false alerts. The simpler threshold baseline remains the recommended operational candidate.
disclaimer: These are research-prototype results on anonymized public telemetry, not operational spacecraft-validation results.
limitations: Telemanom telemetry is anonymized and pre-scaled upstream.
Public training arrays have no official interval labels.
The twenty-channel frozen holdout is not an operational qualification.
The public-data evaluation is offline and is not a live telemetry stream.
